entities.name: Mikuláš Bek
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mikuláš Bek is a Czech musicologist and politician, who served as Minister of Education, Youth and Sports in the cabinet of Petr Fiala from May 2023 to December 2025. He previously served as the Minister of EU Affairs from December 2021 to May 2023.
